text.tspan: GitHub Actions trigger Python scrapers (Selenium). Outputs committed to version-controlled repositories: WHO .xlsx archives, SEARO .csv profiles, PAHO date-stamped country-week files.
Empirical median reporting factors f(c,d) applied to WHO and PAHO at weekly/monthly resolution before harmonisation. Validated at 1-year lag; SEARO excluded (insufficient history).
PAHO: epiweek to calendar month (ISOweek; Supp. Table 1) and cumulative to incident counts. WHO/SEARO: retain monthly totals. Negative month-on-month differences set to NA.
Where WHO Global overlaps PAHO or SEARO, regional dashboard counts are preferred.
One row per country-month: ISO3, date, cases, source (PAHO/SEARO/WHO), Data Status (Observed/Unobserved).
12-month dengue season from circular mean of lowest-case month.
Mean monthly proportions P(m); exclude seasons with <5
Estimate seasonal total C_s = C(<=k) / P(<=k); impute missing recent months C_m = C_s x P(m) using historic seasonal profile.
Leave-one-season-out validation. APE quantiles by country, lead-time and season timing yield 50% and 95% multiplicative prediction intervals around point forecasts.
Compare current season to historic baseline; generate country and regional observatory outputs.
Scraper and pipeline code on GitHub (DengueGlobalObservatory). Version history of extractions and outputs.
Global Dengue Observatory — Data pipeline and methods
